messages:
Maya: Heads-up: new kernel-selector rollout on pool-C coincided with a p95 increase (~+7%) for tiny requests (<=48 tokens). Dash: https://dash.redwood/pool-C/perf :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Ethan: On it. First glance at batching histograms: running_batch_p50 dropped 5 -> 2. KV cache local hit-rate down ~4%.
Renee: Got a quick flamegraph from an affected host. Preproc (parse+tokenize) slices are larger than before; tokenize shows a spike after we merged the unicode normalizer change last week.
Maya: Sample span (trimmed):
```
parse_request    0.7ms
tokenize         3.6ms  (unicode-normalize + detokenize pass)
kvcache_lookup   0.6ms (miss -> remote fetch 4.8ms)
kernel_exec     22.4ms  (vectorized kernel)
grpc_writev      6.1ms (3 frames)
```
Ethan: vectorized kernel seems to be winning selector score for these model-shapes, but it's heavier per-request. Lower throughput per core -> smaller arrival batching -> amplified kvcache hot-shard misses -> remote fetch penalty -> extra smallwrite frames. Feedback loop.
Renee: Also noticed increase in HTTP/1.1 chunking for some clients; more network syscalls per response.
Maya: Short-term mitigations: 1) feature-flag rollback for selector on pool-C, 2) add a gating rule in selector: prefer "scalar_light" kernel when observed running_batch_p90 < 3 OR median_token_len < 60, 3) emit per-host labels/metrics: kernel_variant, running_batch_histogram, kvcache_remote_rate, grpc_smallwrite_count.
Ethan: Agree. Long-term: incorporate a host_preproc_and_network_cost estimate into kernel scoring (not just token-throughput). Selector should estimate end-to-end token latency including parse+tokenize+expected network cost for typical request shape.
Renee: Also propose an experiment: move tokenization into a co-located sidecar for ultra-small requests and measure end-to-end tail. Sidecar removes tokenize CPU from host but adds RPC overhead. We should simulate both on the replay job.
Maya: Can we queue a replay now? 3k requests, 32 tokens, model-B shape. Want to reproduce the p95 delta.
trace-bot: Replay job queued: replay/1765439999-poolC-3k-32t. Link: https://replay.redwood/jobs/1765439999. ETA ~6m.
Ethan: Ops, please run soft rollback if possible so we can confirm baseline.
ops-bot: Received rollback request. Toggling selector config flag on pool-C -> previous behavior. Will report when done.
Renee: Meanwhile I'll attach perf counters: cpu cycles per stage, L3 misses during kvcache lookup, and a smallwrite distribution histogram. That will help prove the feedback loop.
ops-bot: Rollback complete at 12:14:02 UTC. Pool-C p95 trending back to baseline.
Ethan: After rollback, let's add alert rules for: running_batch_p50 drop >2, kvcache_remote_rate >1%, grpc_smallwrite_count increase >25% so we catch this faster. Also put a microbenchmark (5k small requests) into the preflight check for selector rollouts.
Maya: Good. Renee, please open the RFC that includes: profiling artifacts (flamegraphs, perf counters), proposed selector gate, selector scoring change to include host_preproc_and_net_cost, and the sidecar simulation plan.
Renee: Will do. I'll include replay traces and the sidecar vs host simulation numbers.
trace-bot: Replay finished: delta confirmed on canary vectorized kernel group. Attaching traces to RFC.
Maya: Closing incident for now. Follow-ups in RFC and CI work. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
